messages:
anya: Quick design review — dropped a Figma link for the latency dashboard tweaks: time-range presets, sampling slider, and the heatmap legend. Can folks skim and call out any copy/accessibility nits? https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx
marcus: looked — nice. main thing: the p95 axis label feels cramped when the range is <1m. can we shorten or add wrapping?
frida: I think we should prefer 'P95 latency (ms)' vs 'p95 latency (ms)' for consistency with other headings. also suggest a tooltip: 'P95 = 95th percentile, higher values indicate slow tail latency.'
ajun: small nit — the preset buttons (1h, 6h, 24h) don't show keyboard focus clearly. needs a 3px visible ring and focus-visible state.
julien: +1 on focus ring. for color scale on heatmap: current linear gradient hides low-frequency hotspots. can we try a hybrid scale (log for low counts, linear for high) or add an intensity overlay?
samir: hybrid scale makes sense. also think about a legend label change: 'Request density' -> 'Requests / minute' to be explicit.
anya: good calls. on sampling controls: current copy reads 'Sampling: 10%'. product wants a short explanation inline. suggestions?
frida: tooltip: 'Sampling reduces data volume for long ranges. Lower values speed up queries but may hide rare spikes.' keep it <120 chars.
marcus: also add a default behavior note: for ranges >7d, default to 2-5%; for <1d default to 50-100%. avoids surprise.
a11y-bot: Accessibility check: color contrast ratios for the heatmap palette fall below AA for some low-intensity colors. Recommend checking WCAG contrast and offering a high-contrast toggle.
julien: noted. we should add an 'Accessibility' toggle in the top-right of the dashboard and persist in local storage.
samir: microcopy for presets: instead of 'Last 1h' use 'Last 1 hour' (for screen readers full wording is clearer). also aria-label each button: e.g. `\u003cbutton aria-pressed=\"false\" aria-label=\"Select 1 hour range\"\u003e1 hour\u003c/button\u003e`
frida: for live updating charts, add `aria-live=\"polite\"` to the summary region that reads out top-level metrics after update. avoid announcing every single datapoint.
anya: UX question — should the sampling slider be inline with presets or in an overflow panel? product worried about clutter.
marcus: put compact control inline (icon + current value) and expand to a full panel on click. keeps visual noise low.
julien: copy for the compact control: 'Sampling: 10% (click to adjust)'. tooltip: 'Adjust sample rate for query performance; affects heatmap resolution.'
frida: accessibility nit for slider: ensure keyboard arrow keys increment by 1% and page up/down by 10%. aria-valuetext should read 'Sampling 10 percent' not '10'.
anya: thanks. action items: 1) frida will make small copy updates + accessibility notes in Figma, 2) marcus will prototype hybrid color scale and focus ring, 3) julien will spec toggle persistence and compact control copy, 4) samir will update legend wording. I'll open a tiny PR for button attributes and the aria-live wrapper after the figma changes.
samir: timeline?
anya: aiming for a small deploy in two sprints. PRs by EOD next Tuesday if possible.
julien: I'll run contrast checks and post results here.
a11y-bot: Reminder: run the Axe CI job when PRs target `canary/dashboard` branch.
frida: thanks everyone — I'll push the copy changes shortly and ping for a final pass. :sparkles:
